title: Green Shakshuka with Herbs & Yogurt
description: Poached eggs in a bed of wilted spinach, peas and leeks, finished with yogurt and harissa.
ingredients: Small bunch each parsley, coriander, mint
steps: Soften the leek in oil, then wilt in the spinach and stir through the peas, garlic, cumin and herbs.
Make four gaps in the mixture and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook until the whites set, then top with yogurt and harissa.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food green shakshuka

notes: A vegetable-heavy way to hit your greens before noon without it feeling like a salad.
